verdict.rationale: Supabase supports versioning database schema changes via migrations (stored in version control) and branching for reviewing changes before merging to production, plus automatic backups for rollback of data — these give partial coverage of 'version, review, and roll back' for schema/automation changes made via CLI or AI assistant. However there is no dedicated feature for versioning/reviewing/rolling back specific AI-driven automation runs (e.g., cron jobs, edge function deployments, webhook triggers) as discrete units, and community feedback flags migrations/branching as still immature ('biggest weakness', dashboard encourages live prod edits) and no audit/undo tool for agent actions is documented. Missing for 10: a unified automation-run history/audit log tied to AI actions, one-click revert for individual automations (cron/webhooks/functions), and independent confirmation the branching/migration workflow reliably supports rollback of AI-initiated changes.
